name: inspect_android_method
description: Decompile one Android method with smali fallback. Requires explicit overload_index when multiple methods share a name. Reports representation, fallback markers and source truncation; never treats display signatures as exact DEX identities.

__schema0.description: Local APK path; the target is never executed

__schema3.description: Explicit index among same-name methods; required when ambiguous

overload_index.description: Explicit index among same-name methods; required when ambiguous

path.description: Local APK path; the target is never executed
